subject: Língua Inglesa
description_pt: Fazer uso da língua inglesa para resolver mal-entendidos, emitir opiniões e esclarecer informações por meio de paráfrases ou justificativas.

components.description_pt: Usar paráfrase em inglês para esclarecer ou resolver mal-entendidos em interação oral
components.description_en: Use paraphrasing in English to clarify or resolve misunderstandings in oral interaction
components.cc_component_description: Ask questions to clarify or probe others' stated opinions

components.description_pt: Compartilhar e justificar opiniões pessoais com razões durante interações colaborativas
components.description_en: Share and justify personal opinions with reasons during collaborative interactions
components.cc_component_description: Share and justify personal opinions with reasons during collaborative interactions

components.description_pt: Esclarecer informações em inglês fornecendo explicações ou justificativas quando necessário
components.description_en: Clarify information in English by providing explanations or justifications when needed
components.cc_component_description: Pose specific questions to clarify information presented by others in a discussion

cc_matches.description:
Por medio de su repertorio lingüístico y utilizando artefactos multimodales, los estudiantes bi/multilingües podrán interactuar con otros (personas y medios) sobre argumentos para...
* acordar sobre sus propias dificultades y razones para pedir apoyo a alguien de confianza
* establecer qué acciones se necesitan para alcanzar objetivos
* compartir opiniones
* justificar opiniones con razones
* aclarar ideas en respuesta a la retroalimentación
* defender el cambio en el propio pensamiento
Pose and respond to specific questions to clarify or follow up on information, and make comments that contribute to the discussion and link to the remarks of others.

Multilingual learners will…
* Ask questions about others’ opinions
* Support own opinions with reasons
* Clarify and elaborate ideas based on feedback
* Defend change in one’s own thinking
* Revise one’s own opinions based on new information
